method: Port of FEATUREFINDER/TraceFitter.h and .cpp (the trait contract declared by the integrator, filled with the parameter defaults and Param mapping, the Levenberg-Marquardt driver optimize_ and the shared start-value steps) and of FEATUREFINDER/GaussTraceFitter.h and .cpp. The 16 START_SECTIONs of TraceFitter_test.cpp and the 17 of GaussTraceFitter_test.cpp are transcribed with their literals and comparison macros. The Gaussian records of the C2 class-level oracle (class-test fits, degenerate inputs and the 25 fits of the FeatureFinderCentroided_1 seed loop) and a B4 driver (defaults, setParameters, fit failures, start-value boundaries, gnuplot formatting) are retained as fixtures and replayed value by value.
evidence_tier: tier 1 (executed differential: product-SDK libOpenMS; 30,348 recorded floating-point values replayed, plus every recorded status, count, boolean and string) for the start values, the GaussTraceFunctor residuals and Jacobians, the fitted parameters at every recorded budget, every query (bounds, FWHM, area, getValue, the span checks, computeTheoretical, getGnuplotFormula), getDefaults, setParameters and the UnableToFit failures with the state they leave; adapted (C2's optimize_ replica, checked against the library at every budget) for the Levenberg-Marquardt status, nfev, njev and the evaluation sequence; tier 3 for the transcribed class-test sections; tier 4 for the optimize configuration against a direct minimize call, the work ceiling, initial_shape's loops, the refusals of empty traces and out-of-range indices, and non-finite input

context_sources.role: consumer, ported by later packages: sets only max_iteration from fit:max_iterations (lines 152-184, 667-675), chooses the fitter from rt_shape (1897-1909) and rejects fits on true span checks
B1's computeIntensityProfile, getPeakCount and getRTBounds, read by the fitter
operator long int: a non-integer max_iteration is a ConversionError
checkDefaults (lines 1066-1169): unknown keys warn, wrong types and invalid strings throw InvalidParameter
toStr(char) is std::string(1, c), used for the gnuplot function name
UnableToFit(file, line, function, name, message): getName() is the name, what() the message

class_test_review.literal_extraction: All literals are transcribed verbatim, including the f32 intensity literals with digits beyond f32 precision. GaussTraceFitter_test.cpp fits once before its sections and sets the theoretical intensities to 0.4 and 0.6 inside the fit section, which the later gnuplot section then reads; each Rust test rebuilds that state in the same order. TraceFitter_test.cpp's NotImplemented subclass becomes DerivedTraceFitter, whose fallible methods return Error::Unsupported and whose queries return NaN and count the call; the two NOT_TESTABLE sections are kept as empty tests; that the trait provides no method is checked by a compile_fail doctest.
class_test_review.comparison: GaussTraceFitter_test.cpp sets TOLERANCE_RELATIVE(1.001) before its sections, so TEST_REAL_SIMILAR is isRealSimilar with ratio_max_allowed 1.001 and absdiff_max_allowed 1e-5 (ClassTest.cpp:35-38 and 364-470), transcribed in f64. TEST_EQUAL is exact equality; TEST_EXCEPTION(Exception::NotImplemented, ...) becomes Err(Error::Unsupported(_)) or the counted NaN query.

oracle.evidence_label: oracle-generated (tier 1 executed differential); adapted for the C2 optimize_ replica
oracle.sdk: product-sdk, Debug build of core 4fdec46b205459b92e7d3b9e56df5d8e912d5c85, AppleClang 21.0.0, C++23, Eigen 5.0.1
oracle.revision_equivalence: 4fdec46 is an ancestor of bc9cc12; TraceFitter.h/.cpp, GaussTraceFitter.h/.cpp and FeatureFinderAlgorithmPickedHelperStructs.h/.cpp hash identically at both, and product-sdk/include equals the pin for the headers (C2 manifest, source_files).
oracle.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<scratch>/home OPENMS_HOME_PATH=<scratch>/home OPENMS_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=ON OPENMS_DATA_PATH=product-sdk/share/OpenMS/4.0.0, per-run scratch working directory, perl alarm 600 s
oracle.reproduction: run.sh runs the driver twice from separate scratch directories and requires byte-identical output; extract_c2.py is run over the C2 omp1 and omp4 results and the outputs must be byte-identical.
oracle.comparison: Start values, residuals, Jacobians and queries evaluated on the oracle's fitted parameters within 1e-14 relative; fitted parameters, sweep parameters and the evaluation path within 1e-9 relative; statuses, nfev, njev, evaluation sequences, booleans, strings and budget boundaries exactly. Four of the driver's own ill-conditioned start-value fits (n4_boundary, merged_profile, leading_max, trailing_max) carry bounds of 1e-8, 1e-8, 1e-3 and 1e-2: the expected values are the oracle's, the bounds are the next power of ten above the port's own largest measured deviation, not oracle values. Their start values are bit-identical; the driver recorded no functor evaluations for them; the gap persists with the oracle platform's exp and log, so it does not come from exp or log and most likely arises in the Levenberg-Marquardt solver (B3 solver-fidelity item; the mechanism is not established). Measured on Linux x86-64 (IBMI dax, glibc 2.39) with stable Rust and 1.85.0, default and no default features: 30,348 floating-point values compared, 25,249 bit-identical; start values, residuals, Jacobians and queries 0 deviation everywhere; class-test fits 2.5e-12, FeatureFinderCentroided_1 fits 6.4e-10. On macOS arm64 (Apple libm; independent review run of 46be7d2) the same deviations hold, with 16,696 instead of 16,699 bit-identical FeatureFinderCentroided_1 values and different fits in cases that pass through an exp argument where the libraries differ (start.tie4_smoothed 0 vs 3.74e-13, start.flat_alpha_ge_1 5.95e-15 vs 2.95e-11, start.trailing_max 1.49e-3 vs 1.72e-3).
oracle.platform_math: exp and log are the platform C library's, so fitted parameters are not bit-identical across platforms. At the 3,972 residual points the oracle recorded, glibc (dax) and Apple libm (macOS arm64) both reproduce every C++ residual and Jacobian entry bit for bit. Over the 37,080 distinct exp and 25 log arguments the tests reach (../oracle/gauss-trace-fitter/exp-simulation), glibc and Apple libm disagree at 70 exp arguments; glibc is not correctly rounded at 31, Apple libm at 69, both misround 15 identically; log agrees everywhere. Substituting Apple libm's values for exp and log on dax reproduces the macOS run, so the C library is the whole cross-platform difference. Substituting correctly rounded values passes every test and criterion (residuals and Jacobians 0 deviation at every recorded point) with fewer bit-identical values: class tests 6,355 of 10,461 (8,255 with either platform library), FeatureFinderCentroided_1 16,658 of 19,572. The libm crate's exp differed from the platform libraries at 362 recorded evaluations by one unit in the last place, moving residuals by up to 9.1e-12 relative (breaking the 1e-14 criterion) and FeatureFinderCentroided_1 sigma by up to 1.13e-9. Platform library versus correctly rounded exp/log is an integrator decision; B5-EGH must make the same choice.

source_anchors.operation: defaults: max_iteration 500 and weighted 'false' with valid strings true/false, both advanced
updateMembers_: max_iterations_ from the integer, weighted_ = (value == "true")
optimize_: data_count < num_params throws UnableToFit-FinalSet 'Skipping feature, we always expect N>=p'

Eigen LevenbergMarquardt with default parameters and maxfev = max_iterations_; status <= ImproperInputParameters throws 'Could not fit the gaussian to the data: Error <status>'; otherwise x is copied back and getOptimizedParameters_ called
copy constructor and assignment copy height_, x0_ and sigma_, not region_rt_span_
getValue: height_ * exp(-0.5 * pow2(rt - x0_) / pow2(sigma_))
GaussTraceFunctor::operator(): (baseline + theo * height * exp(c_fac * pow2(rt - x0)) - intensity) * weight, trace then peak order
setInitialParameters_: zero-padded five-point running mean skipped for N <= 3, first strict maximum, half-maximum walks, alpha >= 1 gives sigma 1.0

native_boundaries: exp and log are the platform C library's (f64::exp, f64::ln), as the source's; fitted parameters therefore differ in their last bits between glibc and Apple libm (see oracle.platform_math); the libm crate was measured and rejected, a correctly rounded exp/log is left to the integrator
Traces without any peak are refused with the N>=p error before the fitter changes; the source reads past the end of its empty profile
compute_theoretical returns Error::InvalidValue for an index past the peaks; the source indexes unchecked

optimize checks levenberg_marquardt::preflight_points (1,000,000 residuals, 64 MiB Jacobian) and caps maxfev at MAX_RESIDUAL_WORK / values (2^30 residual evaluations in total, at least 1,073 evaluations); when that cap is below the configured budget and the solver stops on it, the fit is refused instead of continuing. A fit that ends before the cap, or at the cap's evaluation with status 1-3, is unchanged; one whose natural end at exactly the cap's evaluation would be status 4, 6, 7 or 8 is refused, because the budget test precedes those tests
Clone copies region_rt_span, which the source copy leaves uninitialised; members the source leaves uninitialised start at zero

TraceFitterParams::from_param returns unknown keys as warnings and keeps only the two known values; validation messages are the Param module's wording; from_param refuses a max_iteration outside i32 ('parameter value cannot be converted to i32', from crate::param's restriction check), which to_param writes and the executed source accepts and stores (../oracle/gauss-trace-fitter/param-range: 2^31, 3,000,000,000, -2^31 - 1, i64::MAX); FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked hands the fitter values below 2^31 only
fit borrows the traces immutably; area, the span checks and gnuplot_formula take &self
gnuplot_formula writes a non-ASCII function name as UTF-8; numbers follow format::file_info::text_format::ostream_g at precision 6
optimize_with_status additionally returns the accepted LmStatus

cpp_defect_candidates.status: unconfirmed candidate (source review; not executed, because it reads an uninitialised value)
cpp_defect_candidates.behaviour: region_rt_span_ is not copied, so checkMaximalRTSpan on the copy reads an indeterminate value

cpp_defect_candidates.status: candidate (executed: the recorded Jacobian carries the factor)
cpp_defect_candidates.behaviour: the sigma derivative is multiplied by 0.125 instead of 1, so the Levenberg-Marquardt path and the evaluation-budget boundaries follow a wrong derivative
cpp_defect_candidates.proposed_fix: drop the factor, after measuring the effect on FeatureFinderCentroided outputs

cpp_defect_candidates.trigger: traces whose intensities are all zero
cpp_defect_candidates.behaviour: height 0 gives alpha = 0/0 and sigma NaN; the residuals are NaN, Eigen stops with CosinusTooSmall, and the fit is accepted with a NaN sigma
cpp_defect_candidates.proposed_fix: refuse a non-positive height or a non-finite start value with UnableToFit

cpp_defect_candidates.trigger: traces without any peak; an index past a trace's peaks
cpp_defect_candidates.behaviour: smoothed[max_index] and trace.peaks[k] are read out of bounds

cpp_defect_candidates.function: TraceFitter::checkMinimalRTSpan, checkMaximalRTSpan, the max_iteration parameter and optimize_'s message
cpp_defect_candidates.behaviour: the span checks are documented with the opposite meaning of both implementations; max_iteration is called a number of iterations but is Eigen's maxfev; the EGH model's failure says 'gaussian'
cpp_defect_candidates.rust_handling: the trait documents the implementations' meaning
